authority.official_broad_domain_meaning: Распознавать части речи и их грамматические признаки.
authority.official_program_provenance: EDSOO Federal Working Program Russian 5-9, 2025 / PUBLIC_OFFICIAL_PDF

decisions.label_ru: Как определить часть речи: значение, вопрос, признаки и роль
decisions.boundary_guard: Identify part of speech from the combined evidence of grammatical meaning, morphology, forms and syntactic function in context; a single question, suffix, ending or surface form is insufficient, and this bounded semantic does not grant morphology-norm or orthography mastery.

Classify grammatical features only after the part of speech and form are established, separating lexeme-stable properties from form-dependent properties and checking category applicability; one part of speech's feature list cannot be transferred to another and unavailable categories cannot be invented.

Perform morphology analysis from contextual identification through part of speech, normative initial form, stable and form-dependent features, then syntactic function; the initial form must belong to the same lexeme, and a broad morphology attempt cannot substitute for component-specific independent evidence.

explicit_non_acceptances.reason: The broad official domain establishes morphology scope but does not prove one-to-one object binding for the three bounded components; object accounting remains unchanged.
Normative form production and correction are related downstream capabilities, not exact owners of generic part-of-speech identification, feature classification or full morphology analysis.
Part-of-speech recognition can be prerequisite evidence for orthographic decisions but does not grant exact orthographic mastery.
